name: com.salonrenter/salonrenter-muse
title: SalonRenter for Muse
description: Search live salon suites and booths for rent near you, check tour times, and book a tour.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search published salon suites, booths, chairs, and entire salons. city or lat and lng are required. Results sort ok prices first; unusual and invalid prices come last. weeklyPrice is the low end of the posted price converted to USD per week, and is null when the price is invalid. priceQuality is ok, unusual, or invalid (null when no price is posted). Unusual and invalid prices are unverified and are not typical rents; priceNote explains the check, and the owner can confirm the current price. likelyJobAd marks job posts, which are not rentals. Results are one page of one stable order. total counts only the listings that match the filters in this call. has_more is true when more matches remain. Pass offset or the returned cursor to get the next page. A listing is not repeated on a later page. Each page stays under 25,000 characters.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Get one published listing by id. Owner contact is not included. weeklyPrice is the low end of the posted price converted to USD per week, and is null when the price is invalid. priceQuality is ok, unusual, or invalid (null when no price is posted). Unusual and invalid prices are unverified and are not typical rents; priceNote explains the check, and the owner can confirm the current price. likelyJobAd marks job posts, which are not rentals.

tools.name: city_rents
tools.description: Weekly salon suite and chair rent for one US state. state is a required 2-letter code, such as FL. Pass city with state for one city, such as Orlando. City match is case-insensitive: exact name, then a name that starts with the city, then a name that contains it. Without city, markets are the largest by usable posted-price count. limit defaults to 25 and maxes at 100. Only markets with at least 8 usable posted prices. Counts are spaces within 25 miles. When truncated is true, raise limit or pass city.

tools.name: get_tour_availability
tools.description: List open tour slots for a published listing. month is YYYY-MM. When tour booking is not supported, slots is empty and tours_enabled is false. When tours are on but this month has no open times, message says so and suggests an inquiry. Draft listings are not returned.

tools.name: send_inquiry
tools.description: Sends the listing owner an inquiry from the signed-in renter account. Requires sign-in. The renter name and email come from the account. The same account, listing, and message within 2 minutes returns the existing inquiry id with duplicate true and does not notify the owner again.

tools.name: request_tour
tools.description: Requests a tour on an open slot when the owner has turned agent tours on. tourDate is YYYY-MM-DD and tourTime is HH:MM. Requires sign-in. The renter name and email come from the account.

tools.name: save_search_alert
tools.description: Saves a search alert on the signed-in renter account. city or state is required. Alert emails go to the account email address.

tools.name: my_activity
tools.description: List the signed-in renter inquiries, tour requests, and alerts. No message bodies.
